summary: OWNER_DIRECT_REVERSIBLE_UI_RELEASE per skill-release V3.0. Owner Production evidence rejects the V2.47.198 six-toolbox switcher as visually immature and asks how new tool URLs are actually added. V2.47.199 keeps Start as the sole canonical URL authority, rebuilds the six professional toolboxes as one formal segmented menu, renames the action to 添加工具, restores the classification editor on the current one-page route, and exposes explicit 专业工具箱 / optional 工作分组 choices inside the existing canonical Start add/edit forms. Placement is stored only through existing Start tags (视图:工具 / 场景:* / 工具分组:*); no second Tools database, schema, migration, auth/security, updater mechanism, provider/server or automatic Production write. Existing resources remain backward-compatible and heuristic grouping remains available when Owner has not fixed a classification. OWNER_PREVIEW_RUNTIME=POST_RELEASE_REQUIRED; OWNER_REAL_USE=POST_PRODUCTION_REQUIRED; MATERIAL_UI_IA_CHANGE=YES; PRODUCTION_AUTO_APPLY=NO; rollback to v2.47.198 must PASS.
